settings.editor: 🛡️ Free first consultation — evening & weekend appointments available.
A full-service firm serving Greater Fredericton since 1978 — working together to serve you with personal care and legal rigour.

We take a team approach to practising law, so every client benefits from our combined legal expertise. Our clients range from small companies to large corporations, as well as families and private individuals.
Calabrese Whitehead was established in 1978 with two lawyers. Now Whitehead Miles & Allen LLP, it has grown into a multi-practice, full-service firm serving the Greater Fredericton Area.

Incorporations, agreements and day-to-day counsel that keep your business on solid ground.

settings.title: Clear terms, agreed before any work begins.

tabs.tab_title: Do you offer a free first consultation?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. Your first conversation is complimentary and without obligation — we’ll hear your situation, give you an honest read on the path, and agree on scope and fees before any work begins.
Depending on the matter, we work on fixed fees or hourly rates — always agreed in writing up front, with no surprises.

tabs.tab_title: Do you serve clients in both English and French?
tabs.tab_content: Entirely. Every advisor at the firm practises and corresponds in both official languages.
